brief:
Costa Rica barred Francesca Albanese, a UN expert who has documented alleged Israeli conduct in Gaza, from entering the country, Al Jazeera English reported. The decision prompted Israeli officials to celebrate the move, though the basis for the ban remained unclear. Albanese, who serves as a UN special rapporteur, has published findings characterizing Israel's military operations in Gaza as genocide.

The ban drew criticism from observers who questioned Costa Rica's reasoning and independence. Albanese's work has focused on documenting alleged violations during Israel's assault on Gaza, which began following the October 7 attack by Hamas. Her exclusion raised questions about pressure on the Central American nation regarding its stance toward the conflict.
dek: Costa Rica is under pressure over its decision to bar the UN expert who has documented Israel's genocidal war on Gaza.
title: Costa Rica bans UN investigator critical of Israel's Gaza war
